datasets.name: OrDSCustomers
datasets.sql:
select c.ID, c.Name, c.INN, c.Open_Dat, c.Close_Dat, c.Cust_TYPE, c.op_id,
       
       decode(c.nerezident,0,'Q/Rezident',1,'Rezident','') as nerezident, 
       (select name from prinad where id=c.prinad_kod) as prinad, 
       c.short_name,
       (SELECT name FROM qrp_klie where id=c.group_klie) as group_klie,
       (SELECT name FROM vid_sob where id=c.vid_sob) as vid_sob,
       (SELECT name FROM org_prav where id=c.org_sob) as org_sob,
       (SELECT name FROM sferadey where id=c.sfera_dey) as sfera_dey,
       (SELECT name FROM otrasli where id=c.otrasl) as otrasl,
       (SELECT name FROM nalog where id=c.nalog_kod) as nalog_kod,
       (select cntr_name from countries where id=ci.citizenship)as cntr_name,
       c.kod_okpro,
       c.dat_nal, c.dat_ustav, c.bik, c.otv_lico, c.otv_passport,
       c.otv_issued, c.otv_isdate, c.old_inn,
       (SELECT name FROM categories where id= c.category) as category,
       c.incorporation_number, c.tph_contact_type,
       c.tph_communication_type, c.tph_number, c.address_type,
       c.address, c.city, c.country_code, c.director_id, c.email, c.url,
       c.incorporation_state, c.incorporation_cntr, c.tph_extension,
       c.tph_zip, c.tph_country_prefix, c.tph_state, c.risk_categ,
       ci.soname, 
       ci.name as ci_name,  -- name
       ci.lastname, ci.birthday,
       ci.birthplace, ci.passer, ci.paspnum, ci.paspdate, ci.paspplace,
       ci.city as ci_city, -- city
       ci.address as ci_address,  --address
       ci.workplace, ci.phone_w, ci.phone_h, ci.phone_m,
       ci.e_mail, 
       ci.url as ci_url,   --url
       ci.recomendation, ci.garanted,
       ci.otv_passport as ci_otv_passport, --otv_passport
       ci.otv_issued as ci_otv_issued, --otv_issued
       ci.otv_isdate as ci_otv_isdate, --otv_isdate
       ci.note, ci.work, ci.test, ci.fam_status,
       ci.sex, ci.adrs_state, ci.birth_state, ci.fakt_adress, ci.child_info,
       ci.doc_type, ci.passpin, ci.passexpire, ci.reg_zip,
       ci.doc_country, ci.citizenship2, ci.citizenship3, ci.fakt_country,
       ci.fakt_city, ci.fakt_zip, ci.work_place, ci.work_post,
       ci.work_adress, ci.work_phone, 
       ci.tph_contact_type as ci_tph_contact_type, --tph_contact_type
       ci.tph_country,
       ci.tph_country_code, ci.tph_city, 
       ci.tph_state as ci_tph_state,  -- tph_state
       ci.tph_zip as ci_tph_zip, --tph_zip
       ci.tph_country_prefix as ci_tph_country_prefix, --tph_country_prefix
       ci.tph_adress, 
       ci.tph_communication_type as ci_tph_communication_type, --tph_communication_type
       ci.tph_number as ci_tph_number, --tph_number
       ci.tph_extension as ci_tph_extension, --tph_extension
       ci.contact_type, ci.cuinfaml,
       ci.risk_categ as ci_risk_categ , --risk_categ
       ci.work_adrs_spec, ci.work_strnumb, ci.work_city,
       ci.work_state, ci.work_zip, ci.work_cntr, ci.work_phone_spec,
       ci.work_phconttype, ci.work_phoppref, ci.work_phext, ci.work_phcode,ci.birthday,ci.passer,ci.paspnum,ci.passpin,

(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id) as USER_NAME,
  (select filialid from sba_objinf where obj=(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id)) filial_id,
  (select name from filial_t where id=(select filialid from sba_objinf where obj=(select name from user$ where id=c.op_id))) filial_name
  
from Customers c, custinfo ci
where c.id=ci.idcust
and c.ID in (select KLI_ID from Account where Filial =0) and
c.close_dat is null and (c.open_dat between (:BegDate) and (:EndDate))
and (c.name like:pName) and (nvl(c.cust_type,0) in (:P_CUSTTYPE))
order by c.ID

datasets.name: OrDSDates
datasets.sql:
Select min(C.open_dat) as CMinDate,max(C.open_dat) as CMaxDate,
          min(A.open_dat) as AMinDate,max(A.open_dat) as AMaxDate
From Customers C, Account A

datasets.name: OrDSAccount
datasets.sql:
select ac.id,ac.ACC_NO,ac.Name,val.Val_Name,ac.Open_Dat,ac.Close_Dat,
       ac.Kli_ID,abs(ten.Ostat),abs(ten.Pok_Ostat), ten.datdate as Tarix,
       ac.tipacc as symbol, f.Name as Filial, cu.name as cust_name,ac.bal_cn1,cu.inn as cust_voen,ct.name as cust_type
from Account ac, Avalute val, ArchOst ten, Filial f, customers cu, cust_types ct
where-- ac.kli_ID=1 and 
(ac.open_dat between :BegDate and :EndDate) and ten.datdate=:BalDate
 and (ac.name like:pName) and f.id=ac.filial and cu.id=ac.kli_id and ct.id=cu.cust_type

datasets.name: OrDSFilials
datasets.sql:
select -1 ID, 'Ümumi' Name from dual
union
select ID, NAME from Filial

datasets.name: OrDSDocs
datasets.sql:
select 
 p.dat,a1.acc_no as Debit,a1.Name as DName,a2.acc_no as Credit,a2.Name as CName,
 p.ammount,p.lammount,p.ammount_c,p.name, a1.tipacc as d_symbol,a2.tipacc as c_symbol 
from provarch p, account a1, account a2
where 
    (dat between (:BegDate) and (:EndDate))
        and (p.debt in (select id from account where acc_no=:Acc_NO)
      or p.kredit in (select id from account where acc_no=:Acc_NO))
  and (p.debt=a1.id and p.kredit=a2.id)
